best_match.fbbt_definition: Glial cell of the adult that is associated with the cell body rind of the brain or the ventral nerve cord.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00001297 'cell body glial cell', a current FBbt cell term. FBbt has the adult-specific variant FBbt:00059270 'adult cell body glial cell', which denotes the same cells in the adult; the data are from adult flies, so the adult term is used.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Glial cell with a nucleus amongst the neuronal cell bodies in the cell body rind. It is irregularly shaped, with processes that enclose the neuronal cell bodies.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: The authors' term; FBbt has the adult-specific variant, preferred because the data are from adult flies (curation rule 4).

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00059270 'adult cell body glial cell' (adult variant of the authors' term), exact match.
